catalog_title: TM Forum SID (GB922), eTOM (GB921) & QUDT Reference Vocabulary Catalog

sid_classes.label: Party
sid_classes.description: An individual or organization that has a relationship with the enterprise.

sid_classes.label: Organization
sid_classes.description: A group of people identified by shared interests or purpose, such as a corporate business entity.

sid_classes.label: Individual
sid_classes.description: A single human being acting as a contact, technician, or residential subscriber.

sid_classes.label: Party Role
sid_classes.description: The part played by a party in a given context with specific characteristics and rights.

sid_classes.label: Market Segment
sid_classes.description: A grouping of parties, geographic areas, or sales channels that share common commercial requirements.

sid_classes.label: Sales Channel
sid_classes.description: The mechanism or organization through which products and services are sold to customers.

sid_classes.label: Marketing Campaign
sid_classes.description: A coordinated series of promotional activities designed to drive product adoption.

sid_classes.label: Competitor
sid_classes.description: A rival telecom operator offering competing connectivity services in the same market.

sid_classes.label: Customer
sid_classes.description: An enterprise party or organization that subscribes to commercial telecom products and holds an active Master Service Agreement.

sid_classes.label: Customer Account
sid_classes.description: An arrangement by which a customer is administered and billed for subscribed services.

sid_classes.label: Customer Bill
sid_classes.description: A financial invoice issued to a customer for recurring and usage-based telecom charges.

sid_classes.label: Applied Customer Billing Rate
sid_classes.description: A financial charge, tax, or discount applied to a customer bill during a billing cycle.

sid_classes.label: Customer Credit Profile
sid_classes.description: Creditworthiness, dunning level, and payment risk score associated with a customer.

sid_classes.label: Product Offering
sid_classes.description: A commercial offering marketed to customers in the product catalog.

sid_classes.label: Product
sid_classes.description: A procured commercial telecom offering binding a customer agreement to one or more CustomerFacingServices.

sid_classes.label: Product Specification
sid_classes.description: The invariant characteristics and rules defining a type of commercial product.

sid_classes.label: Product Order
sid_classes.description: A customer request to provision, upgrade, modify, or cease a telecom product.

sid_classes.label: Product Price
sid_classes.description: The recurring monthly or one-off monetary tariff associated with a product.

sid_classes.label: Customer Facing Service
sid_classes.description: An active Layer 2 Ethernet or wavelength connectivity circuit directly visible to and contracted by an enterprise customer.

sid_classes.label: Service Specification
sid_classes.description: Standardized commercial catalog SKU defining bandwidth tier, SLA packet-loss ceiling, availability target, and autonomous remediation eligibility.

sid_classes.label: Resource Facing Service
sid_classes.description: Internal network transport and access bearer service realizing a CustomerFacingService across PE routers, OLT ports, fiber spans, and CPE devices.

sid_classes.label: Service Order
sid_classes.description: An internal fulfillment instruction to activate or reconfigure a CustomerFacingService or ResourceFacingService.

sid_classes.label: Service Level Agreement Clause
sid_classes.description: Contractual or catalog SLA clause specifying packet-loss thresholds, mean time to repair, service credit penalties, and VIP escalation rules.

sid_classes.label: Physical Resource
sid_classes.description: A physical network equipment asset deployed in the provider core, access plant, or customer demarcation point.

sid_classes.label: OLT Optical Port Resource
sid_classes.description: Optical Line Terminal transceiver port terminating the access fiber span and providing real-time gNMI DDM optical telemetry.

sid_classes.label: Customer Premises Equipment Resource
sid_classes.description: Physical demarcation switch or router installed at the enterprise customer site.

sid_classes.label: Provider Edge Router Resource
sid_classes.description: Metro or core Provider Edge router aggregating L2 Ethernet access bearers.

sid_classes.label: Physical Resource Specification
sid_classes.description: Vendor equipment model specification defining hardware capabilities, supported optical transceivers, and DDM calibration thresholds.

sid_classes.label: Logical Resource
sid_classes.description: A non-physical network resource such as a VLAN ID, IP subnet, BGP ASN, or MPLS label.

sid_classes.label: Optical Calibration Profile
sid_classes.description: Vendor hardware manual optical Digital Diagnostic Monitoring (DDM) power envelope and autonomous laser bias recalibration specification.

sid_classes.label: Engaged Party
sid_classes.description: A vendor, partner, or field engineering contractor engaged in network operations.

sid_classes.label: Vendor
sid_classes.description: An external network equipment manufacturer supplying optical transceivers, OLT shelves, or CPE routers.

sid_classes.label: Trouble Ticket
sid_classes.description: TMF621 operational assurance ticket tracking network incidents, automated remediations, or field fiber splicing dispatches.

sid_classes.label: Work Order
sid_classes.description: A field engineering task instruction dispatched to an outside-plant technician.

sid_classes.label: Geographic Site
sid_classes.description: A physical building, central office, point of presence, or customer premises location.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.1.1 Market Strategy & Policy
etom_processes.description: Market segmentation, competitive analysis, and target market definition.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.2.1 Product & Offer Development
etom_processes.description: Lifecycle management of commercial catalog SKUs and SLA service specifications.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.3.3 Order Handling
etom_processes.description: Customer order capture, credit validation, and commercial order tracking.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.3.7 Problem Handling
etom_processes.description: Customer-facing service problem reception, SLA triage, root-cause correlation, and customer status notification.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.3.8 Service Quality & SLA Management
etom_processes.description: Monitoring of contractual SLA thresholds, packet-loss ceilings, and service credit calculations.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.3.10 Billing & Collections Management
etom_processes.description: Invoice generation, VAT/tax calculation, ERP ledger posting, and dunning management.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.4.3 Service Configuration & Activation
etom_processes.description: Automated TMF640 service provisioning and optical parameter reconfiguration.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.4.5 Resource Trouble Management
etom_processes.description: Network resource fault localization, optical transceiver DDM diagnostics, autonomous self-healing, and field technician dispatch.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.4.6 Resource Performance Management
etom_processes.description: Continuous gNMI telemetry collection and optical power envelope monitoring.

etom_processes.label: eTOM 1.5.2 Resource Provisioning
etom_processes.description: Physical CPE, OLT port, and fiber span allocation and inventory binding.
